integrity: A standalone finite-field checker and its recorded output accompany a complete elementary proof; computations are corroborative, not an infinite-domain certificate.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the matrix Lie bracket in the strictly upper triangular 4-by-4 Lie algebra over finite fields. Neither higher orders, group commutator fibers, conjugacy orbit populations, nor independent historical priority are established.
title: Three-stratum Lie-bracket fibers and adjoint ranks of strictly upper triangular four-by-four matrices
